solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Break down in thoroughfare — get energy to start?

indicators.note: says the first pieces go at the front, before the road

parts.note: to dig something is slang for getting it, understanding it
E is the physics symbol for energy
ST is the usual abbreviation for street, a thoroughfare

explanation.surface: A car breaks down in the middle of the road and needs a jolt of power to get going again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to start' puts DIG and E ahead of ST.
explanation.definitionFit: Food is broken down by the stomach when it is digested, so the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Drop sluttish woman yelling outside?

indicators.note: the noise is placed around the slovenly woman, enclosing her

parts.note: a din is loud yelling or racket
sow is an old insult for a slovenly or dirty woman

explanation.surface: Someone abandons a slovenly woman who is shouting outside the house.
explanation.walkthrough: SOW, a female pig, is an old insult for a slovenly woman.
explanation.definitionFit: To drop someone is to reject or abandon them, as a parent might renounce a child.

clue.text: Like some plants to go with price reduced

indicators.note: reduced as in reduced to rubble, so the letters are broken up and rebuilt

explanation.surface: A shopper is told to go for something because its price has been cut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reduced' shuffles TOGOPRICE; 'with' just joins the two fodder pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Geotropic plants grow in response to gravity, roots downward, so the adjective describes some plants.

clue.text: Warrior peculiar as revolutionary, ultimately top-notch

indicators.note: turned round, so the words for peculiar and as are read backwards together

parts.note: rum is British slang for odd or peculiar
A1 means first-rate, and it comes last here; the 1 is written as the letter I

explanation.surface: A strange revolutionary fighter who turns out, in the end, to be first-rate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' turns RUMAS into SAMUR; then AI (A1) goes on the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A samurai was a member of the hereditary fighting class of feudal Japan.

clue.text: Piece of cloth head man presented to King and Queen

indicators.note: the chief is handed over to the royal pair, so he follows them

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king
ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the Queen
a chief is the leader, the head man

explanation.surface: A tribal leader is introduced to the King and Queen and offers them a cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: A kerchief is a square of fabric worn on the head or around the neck.

clue.text: Cup-tie score excited one sort of politician

indicators.note: agitated and stirred up, so the letters are thrown about

explanation.surface: The result of a cup match thrills a particular politician.
explanation.walkthrough: 'excited' rearranges CUPTIESCORE.
explanation.definitionFit: A Eurosceptic is a politician opposed to closer ties with the European Union.

clue.text: Switzerland has ace accommodation to rent out — these?

definitions.text: Switzerland has ace accommodation to rent out — these?

parts.note: CH is the international vehicle code for Switzerland
A is the usual abbreviation for ace in cards
lets are properties let out to tenants

explanation.surface: Switzerland boasts first-class holiday lodgings for hire, and the clue asks what they might be.
explanation.definitionFit: Alpine wooden holiday cottages typical of the Swiss mountains are rented out to visitors.

clue.text: In singing group I will come to the fore — I'm juicy and divine!

indicators.note: the letter named moves up to the front of the group's word

parts.note: a choir is a group of singers
taken as written

explanation.surface: A chorister boasts of stepping forward to sing solo, delighted with themself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'will come to the fore' moves the I of CHOIR to the front.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth this fluid runs in the veins of the gods instead of blood, hence juicy and divine.

clue.text: One offers a defence in favour of long hair

parts.note: to be for something is to support it
a tress is a long lock of hair

explanation.surface: Someone argues in court on behalf of growing long hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A stronghold is built to defend against attack, so it is something that offers defence.

clue.text: Short supply? This person's wild

indicators.note: cut short, so the word for supply loses its last letter

parts.note: a store is a stock or supply
the setter speaking of themself: belonging to me

explanation.surface: Supplies are running low and someone is furious about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Short' removes the E of STORE.
explanation.definitionFit: Stormy weather or a stormy temper is violent and wild.

clue.text: Scope being restricted by a minister?

indicators.note: the range word is hemmed in on both sides by the word for a

parts.note: per means a, as in five pounds a head
reach is the range or scope of something

explanation.surface: A clergyman limits how far something can extend.
explanation.walkthrough: PER means 'a' as in 'ten pounds a head'.
explanation.definitionFit: A minister of religion delivers sermons, so is one who preaches.

clue.text: Military medico has gongs in special cupboards

parts.note: war, as in war effort, relates to the military
DR is short for doctor, a medico
gongs is British slang for medals and honours; OBE is the Order of the British Empire

explanation.surface: An army doctor keeps their medals in purpose-built cabinets.
explanation.definitionFit: These are tall cupboards built specially for hanging clothes.

clue.text: Kitchen cleaner will get it in the neck

definitions.meaning: a scrubbing tool kept by the sink for washing out narrow containers

definitions.text: will get it in the neck
definitions.meaning: to get it in the neck is to be punished; this tool literally goes into a bottle's neck

explanation.surface: A kitchen cleaner is going to be in trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: This cylindrical bristled scrubber is pushed through the narrow neck of a container to clean it.

clue.text: Mischievous type removing what's at front to show boob

indicators.note: the first letter of the word for a naughty child is dropped

parts.note: a terror is a mischievous, badly behaved child

explanation.surface: A naughty child takes something from the front to reveal a blunder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'removing what's at front' drops the T of TERROR.
explanation.definitionFit: Boob is British slang for a silly mistake or blunder.

clue.text: Stupidity that would lead to the blocking out of all news?

definitions.meaning: senselessness, a lack of purpose or meaning

definitions.text: that would lead to the blocking out of all news?
definitions.meaning: the word news is spelt with the four compass points N, E, W, S; without points it vanishes

explanation.surface: Something so foolish it would stop every news report from getting out.
explanation.walkthrough: Compass points N, E, W and S spell NEWS, so taking every point away blanks it out.
explanation.definitionFit: Futility or senselessness is a kind of stupidity, an absence of any purpose.

clue.text: Placid Queen is queasy with this

definitions.meaning: QU, short for Queen, joined with the first half of the answer spells queasy

explanation.surface: A calm monarch feels sick because of something.
explanation.walkthrough: QU (Queen) going with EASY makes QUEASY; the answer splits as EASY plus GOING.
explanation.definitionFit: A relaxed, tolerant person who is not easily upset is calm in the same way.

clue.text: Pheasant shows skill on the up journey — shoot down at the end

indicators.note: says the last piece comes after the others
in a down clue, going up means the word for skill is read backwards

parts.note: art is skill or craft
a go is a turn or trip; to go is to journey
to pan is to criticise harshly, to shoot down

explanation.surface: A game bird is driven up on a shoot and then brought down at the finish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the up' reverses ART to TRA.
explanation.definitionFit: The tragopan is a brightly coloured Asian pheasant.

clue.text: Political issue as certain role is scrapped

indicators.note: torn up and broken into pieces, so the letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: A government post is abolished and becomes a matter of debate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is scrapped' rearranges ASCERTAINROLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Relations between ethnic groups are a perennial topic of political debate.

clue.text: Train mutineer to be orderly after leader has been deposed

indicators.note: put into order, so the remaining letters are rearranged
the first letter of mutineer is removed

explanation.surface: A rebel sailor is to be disciplined now the ringleader has been removed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after leader has been deposed' drops M from MUTINEER; 'to be orderly' rearranges UTINEER.
explanation.definitionFit: A train is the band of attendants following an important person, an entourage.

clue.text: Old Oxbridge player hiding intelligence, being underhand

indicators.note: the sporting word conceals the intelligence measure within it

parts.note: a Blue is a sportsperson who has represented Oxford or Cambridge University
IQ, intelligence quotient, measures intelligence

explanation.surface: A former university sportsman conceals how clever he is, behaving deviously.
explanation.walkthrough: A Blue is awarded for playing for Oxford or Cambridge against the other.
explanation.definitionFit: Oblique means indirect or evasive, not straightforward, hence underhand.

clue.text: Place that may offer shopping opportunities somewhere in Somerset

definitions.text: Place that may offer shopping opportunities
definitions.meaning: a high road lined with shops
A town in Somerset, a county in south-west England

explanation.surface: A spot for retail therapy in a West Country county.
explanation.definitionFit: A road with shops is the classic shopping venue, and it also names a Somerset town.

clue.text: What is ground in the middle flooded by river

indicators.note: the river pours into the middle of the core word

parts.note: the gist is the core or central point of something

explanation.surface: Something at the centre of the land is ground down and then submerged by a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flooded by' puts R inside GIST.
explanation.definitionFit: Grist is corn brought to the mill for grinding.

clue.text: Like a barrister who may attend family party?

definitions.meaning: a relative by marriage, such as a spouse's parent, attends family gatherings

explanation.surface: A lawyer turns up at a relatives' get-together.
explanation.definitionFit: A barrister is engaged in law, and relatives by marriage come to family events.

clue.text: Feature of photographic work to be bland, as Spooner would have had it?

indicators.text: as Spooner would have had it
indicators.note: Reverend Spooner famously swapped the opening sounds of words

parts.note: something bland is said to lack bite, to have no tang
something bland is said to lack bite, to have no tang

explanation.surface: Some photography is meant to look flat and insipid.
explanation.walkthrough: Swapping the opening sounds of LACK BITE gives BACK LIGHT.
explanation.definitionFit: Lighting a subject from behind is a common technique in photography.

clue.text: Numbers gathered round one at end of game — a particular element?

indicators.note: this piece goes after the game word

parts.note: polo is a game played on horseback

indicators.note: the abbreviation for numbers surrounds the one

parts.note: Num is the abbreviation for the Book of Numbers
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Players crowd round one person when a match ends.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at end of' places the NUM-and-I piece after the game, not at the end of its word.
explanation.definitionFit: Polonium is a radioactive chemical element discovered by Marie Curie.

clue.text: Attendant, pretentious person, new character at the back

indicators.note: the last letter of the word is replaced with a different one

parts.note: a squirt is a small, conceited or presumptuous person

explanation.surface: A servant who is a jumped-up nobody with a new person behind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new character at the back' swaps the final T of SQUIRT for E.
explanation.definitionFit: A squire was the knight's attendant who carried his shield and armour.

clue.text: It could suggest I held capital

parts.note: the letters of the city name in a new order spell these two words

explanation.surface: A claim that something might hint at what I once owned.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as wordplay: NEW (rearranged) DELHI gives I HELD.
explanation.definitionFit: New Delhi is the capital city of India.

clue.text: Prime requirement for winning crew?

indicators.note: the first letter of the word winning is taken

parts.note: an eight is a rowing crew of eight oarsmen

explanation.surface: What a rowing crew needs most to win.
explanation.definitionFit: Heavy oarsmen with power behind the stroke are crucial, so heft is what a crew needs.
